provenance.seam: JournalArchiveImporter.process() — the archive VERB's own entry point
provenance.why_v2: v1 was captured at write_structured_import, which this verb NEVER CALLS and which has no production caller at all. It was captured WITH A PASSING CONTROL, and the control certified the wrong seam — a control validates the instrument, not the instrument's relevance.

scenario: target journal holds a same-named entity and NO principal; archive carries a different John Smith who IS a principal

findings.name_keyed_auto_merge: entities_merged is 1 — a DIFFERENT person with the same name was folded into the owner's record, which now carries the stranger's email and alias.
findings.principal_collision_not_reported: principal_collision is null, because the collision check only fires when BOTH sides have a principal. The owner's journal had none.
findings.reports_clean_success: errors is empty and the merge returns normally. Nothing an owner sees says another person's record was merged in.
findings.reindex_failure_is_log_only: the post-merge reindex request was refused and printed to the log; it appears nowhere in the result.
